summary: Defines a new RTCP Extended Report block type for post-repair loss, using run length encoding. It reports which RTP packets are still lost after repair mechanisms such as retransmission or forward error correction have been applied. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: After fixing missing pieces of a video, you want to know which pieces are still missing. This report block tells the sender that, in a short compact form.

questions: what is the post-repair loss rle report block
how to report packet loss after repair in rtcp
